title: Under Armour Celebrates the Off-Season in New "Rest Less" Sportswear Campaign
summary: The campaign spotlights the moment pressure lifts, the curtain drops, and summer begins. In an off-season where unwinding takes on a new meaning, athletes don’t rest - they Rest Less.
body_markdown:
“Today's athletes shape culture just as much as they shape sport, and that's a shift we're embracing through our Sportswear strategy," said Brian Connell, EMEA Brand Director. "Rest Less reflects our belief that performance doesn't stop at the final whistle. By celebrating how our athletes express themselves beyond competition, we're continuing to build a Sportswear offering that sits at the intersection of performance, style, and culture."


Extending the world of *Rest Less* , Under Armour brought the campaign to life at Hotel Armouré, an immersive week-long experience on Marbella's Golden Mile from July 22–28, marking the campaign's final chapter. Athletes, style icons and adventure seekers from across Europe travelled to the experience, including UFC star and Under Armour athlete[Paddy Pimblett](https://www.instagram.com/theufcbaddy/?hl=en) , Under Armour footballer and YouTuber[Tekkerz Kid](https://www.instagram.com/tekkerzkid/?hl=en) , campaign star[Sharky](https://www.instagram.com/ohnosharky/?hl=en) , lifestyle influencers[Molly Marsh](https://www.instagram.com/mollygracemarsh/?hl=en) and[Romell Henry](https://www.instagram.com/uncleromell/?hl=en) , emerging musicians[J Fado](https://www.instagram.com/j_fado/?hl=en) and[Spencer Elmer](https://www.instagram.com/spencerelmer/?hl=en) , and style influencers[Jaycee](https://www.instagram.com/jaycee_yg/) and[Chloe Ellis](https://www.instagram.com/1chloeellis/?hl=en) .


Designed to bring the *Rest Less* mindset into the real world, Hotel Armouré reimagines a luxury private villa as a high-performance destination where laid-back plans go off script. A place where nobody chills, where the unexpected becomes inevitable, and recovery rarely lasts long. Curated by London-based stylist[Trez](https://www.instagram.com/__trezz/) , guests wore bespoke looks from the FW26 collection, seamlessly blending sportswear and high-performance pieces into elevated looks that captured the energy of the experience.


From jet ski mornings to intimate dinners, padel tournaments, and quad bike adventures, guests embraced the *Rest Less* mindset in an unforgettable summer setting. Sports presenter[Nicole Holliday](https://www.instagram.com/nicolehollidayx/?hl=en) hosted the experience, bringing her own interpretation of what it means to “ rest less”. A surprise performance by rising London DJ[Tommy Gold](https://www.instagram.com/tommygold/?hl=en) closed out the week, bringing everyone together in a high-energy send-off.


The Under Armour Rest Less FW26 collection is now available to buy at[UA.com](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.underarmour.co.uk%2Fen-gb%2Ft%2Frestless%2F&data=05%7C02%7Crory.carvalho%40velir.com%7C2a28926dbf144af4785d08dee682b832%7C750f89c4532d43399fd9b605eca241c8%7C1%7C0%7C639201646383800994%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=xZTiVl5une%2B6oG9raUzmuu3jZbrfEGlbCOikuMm3Has%3D&reserved=0) and select retailers.
